content.comment_body: Dear [company_name] support, [product_name] is a helpful application, but its webpage interface appears not very user friendly. In contrast, the template suite for operator interfaces provides a better user experience, which I have observed in [product_name] engineering software. My request is: could you make the objects in [product_name] look as visually appealing as those found in the operator interface template suite? [url]

Posting your question on the user forum alone probably won't get you the answer you need. It’s unlikely that the right people will notice it here. You should submit a formal Support Request instead. Personally, I doubt [company_name] will implement this suggestion.
Thank you for your advice. In other forums, if many users support a feature request, sometimes the product management team considers it for future releases.

analysis.insight_summary: Users note that [product_name]’s web interface is less user-friendly and visually appealing compared to the operator interface template suite available in another engineering tool. There’s a suggestion that enhancing [product_name]’s interface for better visual consistency and design would improve user satisfaction and usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users desire a modern, visually appealing, and intuitive interface in [product_name], similar to the standards in the operator interface template suite.
